result.title: Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents
result.summary: LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\%, compared with 74.23\%--84.54\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 QuantHarness 双层智能体框架：金融专用 Workflow 组织规格、数据落地、构建、测试与审查，Harness Core 约束各阶段的信息、动作与承诺边界；并给出 FinRelBench，从执行成功、需求满足与运行时证据评估策略开发可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 无视觉或多模态成分，但「中间产物如何成为下游状态」的阶段边界控制与运行时证据留存，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新门控、轨迹监督与证据/停止判定提供可核查线索，迁移性待确认。
